name: How do I choose the right contractor for my tub-to-shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your tub-to-shower conversion, look for a general contractor with specific experience in bathroom remodeling and conversions. Check their portfolio, read customer reviews, and ensure they are licensed and insured in California. A reputable contractor will provide a clear, detailed estimate, explain the process thoroughly, and be transparent about timelines and materials. Choose someone who communicates well and understands your vision for the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed and insured contractor with bathroom remodeling experience, good reviews, clear estimates, and strong communication skills.
